content.title: Fixed space | rough stage generation completed interior
content.summary: The geometry of door openings, windows and walls is preserved in a completely locked indoor wide angle, and the same space is realized layer by layer through irreversible stages such as cleaning, surface finishing, flooring, furniture and lighting, and finally the finished state is still in direct contrast with the opening structure.

quick_start.input_format: Object + fixed composition + 4 irreversible production stages + final small movements
quick_start.recommended_input: The original orbital greenhouse starts from a blank white pressure frame, with three circular cabin rings, a dark observation window, exposed ground rails and equipment installation points clear; graphite cooling pipes and thin cyan irrigation lines connect the ground and wall installation points, indicating that the flow only passes along the pipeline once; warm living lights are turned on, and a circle of controlled mist circulates along the greenhouse; membrane walls, pipelines, crops, platforms, cabin rings and observation windows are all readable
required_anchors: Lock one wide composition with at least three structural anchors visible for the full sequence.
Begin from an incomplete but readable shell and complete its base surfaces first.
Populate distinct zones with occupancy or operational components without blocking the spatial comparison.
Use one final activation proof and hold the complete state in the opening composition.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: The geometry of door openings, windows and walls is preserved in a completely locked indoor wide angle, and the same space is realized layer by layer through irreversible stages such as cleaning, surface finishing, flooring, furniture and lighting, and finally the finished state is still in direct contrast with the opening structure.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Lock one architectural or system cross-section and preserve its structural anchors throughout. Begin from an incomplete but spatially readable shell, then apply irreversible completion stages in causal order: cleanup or stabilization, surface envelope, functional infrastructure, occupancy components and one final activation proof. Never move the camera to hide continuity; the finished state must remain directly comparable to the opening geometry.

invariants.rule: Lock one wide composition with at least three structural anchors visible for the full sequence.
invariants.purpose: Makes every later stage directly comparable.
invariants.ablation_failure: Moving the camera can conceal replacement rather than completion.

invariants.rule: Begin from an incomplete but readable shell and complete its base surfaces first.
invariants.ablation_failure: Adding decoration before stabilizing the shell breaks causal construction order.

invariants.rule: Add one functional envelope or infrastructure stage while preserving all structural anchors.
invariants.purpose: Moves from appearance to usable system.
invariants.ablation_failure: Surface recolor alone cannot prove functional progress.

invariants.rule: Populate distinct zones with occupancy or operational components without blocking the spatial comparison.
invariants.purpose: Assigns purpose to the finished shell.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random clutter hides whether the same space persists.

invariants.rule: Use one final activation proof and hold the complete state in the opening composition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending before activation leaves completion ambiguous.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source damaged pale-green apartment shell
the source exact doorways, rear window and corridor layout
the source light wood floor, white walls, sofa, dining chairs and pendant lights
the source Hailuo/MiniMax and AI-generated watermark marks

instantiations.concept: In an original orbital greenhouse cutaway, a locked wide view begins with an empty pressure frame. Membrane walls seal first, coolant and irrigation lines activate, growing racks and work platforms appear, then habitat lights and a circulating mist loop prove the station is operational; three bulkhead rings and one observation port never move.

instantiations.concept: In tactile cardboard stop motion, a fixed theatre cross-section begins as bare support ribs. Painted flats, pulley tracks, acoustic curtains and performer platforms arrive in causal layers; one final cue light and moving fly system prove readiness while the proscenium corners remain registered.
